item.title: Receptor & Reason 2026-09-15 — verification: a single high-density ECoG array in three BRAVO participants decodes speech and gesture simultaneously to drive an avatar, and held-out speech/gesture pairings decode as well as trained ones, so the parallel decoders compose rather than memorize combinations — but context-inclusive training is mandatory, since isolated-only and simultaneous-only models each degrade on the other; in 144 Turkish speakers, surprisal difference (frequency-based minus contextual-LM surprisal) is attenuated across chronic schizophrenia, first-episode psychosis and schizoaffective disorder at every window size, and embedding intrinsic dimensionality is reduced in the two more severe groups — though the two ID estimators disagree on the sign of the ID/surprisal relation (+0.27 vs -0.45), resolving only when neighbourhood scale is varied; K-Bench scores 125 configurations of 33 models across 200 multi-turn suicide, self-harm, domestic-violence and substance-misuse vignettes, measures clinician-clinician agreement first (89% overall but 75% on severity and 66% on suicide), calibrates a frozen judge to 94% of consensus, and finds therapeutic prompting helps only weak configurations while elevated reasoning buys nothing; 26 LLMs fabricate 55% of biomedical references with only ~15% correct in every field, and two same-family models match on verifiability (~77%) while differing 79% vs 29% on author accuracy; AutoScreen re-ranks a leukemia surfaceome screen to lift MUC1, PDPN and LRRC15 from ranks 118, 81 and 1384 to 5, 44 and 659 with all three validated in primary human NK killing assays, and its authors name auditability rather than accuracy as the prerequisite; Emet's 1.5-billion-triple knowledge graph nominates two-target combinations for squamous lung and goes two-for-four in dose-matrix testing, with CDC7/PKMYT1 synergy and a confirmed USP13 mechanism; HypoEvolve makes agent collaboration the manipulated variable via a generational genetic algorithm, gaining most on genetic-association evidence with pretraining exposure unexcluded; a DTA calibration paper finds 23,015 of 91,644 BindingDB Ki labels pinned at exactly pKi 5.00 and declines to call its fix a Ki-to-IC50 conversion; FAERS flags anti-amyloid/aspirin ARIA signals in three of four models but the all-four-model lecanemab/tPA haemorrhage signal rests on five reports; AppSAA knock-in mice accumulate plaque linearly from 6 to 12 months with vascular amyloid by 8 months and no cortical sex effect, giving a CAA-bearing window for ARIA mechanism work; five days of MDMA cuts ethanol intake in msP rats and intra-central-amygdala but not intra-VTA microinjection reproduces it, lowering dynorphin and Oprk1 in amygdala and VTA but not accumbens; and placebo hunger expectations reorganize resting-state mPFC/angular-gyrus and vmPFC/dlPFC coupling in 60 healthy women with no task present
item.description: Twelve items, one thread: verification — several papers today report a headline number and then, in the same paper, report how much of it survives being checked. A cortical implant carrying speech and gesture at once, with held-out pairings proving the decoders compose rather than memorize; a compression deficit in psychotic speech that is real but whose sign depends on which dimensionality estimator you pick, making it a claim about a particular scale of the embedding manifold; a mental-health safety benchmark that measured its own clinicians' disagreement before trusting an automated judge, and found extra reasoning effort buys no safety at all; fifty-five percent of biomedical references fabricated across 26 models, with the sharper lesson that a reference which resolves is not a reference that is right; three agentic target-discovery systems that independently converge on auditability, not accuracy, as the real deliverable, two of them with wet-lab validation and honest hit rates; a quarter of a public affinity training set turning out to be censoring artifact, and authors who refuse to overclaim the fix; an aspirin interaction signal worth acting on next to a thrombolysis signal resting on five case reports; a knock-in Alzheimer's model whose vascular amyloid timeline makes it the right platform for exactly that question; MDMA cutting alcohol intake from the central amygdala rather than the ventral tegmental area, which opens a target that does not require giving anyone MDMA; and a placebo about hunger reorganizing prefrontal coupling at rest, a reminder that the arm we subtract is an active neurobiological state.
